title: Value Profiles for Encoding Human Variation

bias_targets.methodology: Modeling legitimate human label variation and annotator disagreement in subjective tasks (e.g., hate speech, toxicity detection, moral judgments) by estimating the predictive information of annotator representations using an autoencoder setup with natural language value profiles.

Comparing the predictive power (V-information) of intersectional demographic features (e.g., age, gender, race, political affiliation) against individual value profiles to demonstrate that relying solely on demographics flattens intra-group variance and relies on false generalizations.
